title: Miso-Glazed Dual-Tofu & Pura Vida Fire-Roasted Primavera
originalTitle: Miso-Glazed Dual-Tofu & Pura Vida Fire-Roasted Primavera
ingredients: Tofu: 125g Extra Firm (1cm cubes) \+ 125g Medium Firm (2cm cubes).
Vegetables: 250g Pura Vida Fire Roasted Primavera mix.
Glaze: 0.75 tbsp Miso paste \+ 1.5 tbsp water (whisked).
instructions: Sear Tofu: Brown extra firm cubes in a hot non-stick pan (5 mins). Add medium firm cubes (2 mins). Remove all tofu.
Sauté Veg: Dump frozen mix into high-heat pan. Cook undisturbed (2 mins), then toss until hot (4 mins).
Glaze: Return tofu to pan. Reduce heat to medium-low.
Finish: Pour miso mixture over. Toss 45 seconds until coated and liquid evaporates.
Macros (Per 500g): ~385 kcal \| 26g Protein \| 18g Fat \| 16g Net Carbs \| 1,250mg Sodium.
